extracted.intended_audience: general readers, mathematics enthusiasts, students and educators
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and articulate aesthetic criteria that make a mathematical result (exemplified by Euler's identity) feel beautiful to readers — factors such as surprise, accessibility, simplicity, logical clarity, and a sense of discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unexpected connections
rubrics_metrics.description: "Three very strange numbers which are not connected in any evident way combine to give such a normal and familiar result."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beauty arises when elements that appear unrelated are united by a concise relation; the emotional power comes from the surprise and nonobviousness of the connection (Euler's identity used as the canonical example).

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Beauty is enhanced because the explanation "isn't too difficult to see"; advanced expertise not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aesthetic appreciation increases when the core idea can be grasped without specialist background. Explanations that make the insight apparent to thoughtful laypersons or students strengthen the perception of beauty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Linking the unfamiliar to the familiar
rubrics_metrics.description: "Very strange numbers" with "very ordinary and fundamental ones."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elegance often lies in relating exotic or technical objects to basic, well-understood concepts, thereby grounding the surprising element in familiar intuition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logical progression
rubrics_metrics.description: "A sequence of logical steps and identifying patterns" reveals "incredible truths and interconnections."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An orderly, pattern-driven derivation — where each step follows coherently from the previous — contributes to beauty. Clear structure and identifiable patterns let the reader follow the revelation rather than just admire the result.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplicity emerging from complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Arrival at the "seemingly simple numbers 1 and 0" after fairly complex mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results that collapse complicated machinery into a very simple statement or expression are especially beautiful; the contrast between intricate methods and a simple outcome amplifies aesthetic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sense of discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: "Treading a little-known path through the mathematical jungle to reach a secret destination."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beauty includes the feeling of uncovering something hidden or unexpected — a journey-like narrative where exploration and surprise contribute to the emotional reward of the result.
